title: Every quasi-compact pro-etale object has a single covering arrow whose source is the spectrum of a w-contractible ring.
statement: For every scheme X and every quasi-compact object V of its small pro-etale site, there are a commutative ring D, a weakly etale map Spec D to X, and an arrow g from this site object to V such that D is w-contractible and the singleton presieve of g is a pro-etale covering. No quasi-separatedness hypothesis on V or X is required.

proof.text: Choose the affine singleton covering A to V using lem-weil-pbc-proetale-qc-affine-contractible-cover. Apply exists_isWContractibleRing to the coordinate ring of A, obtaining an ind-etale faithfully flat extension D that is w-contractible. Its spectrum arrow is weakly etale and surjective, hence a pro-etale singleton cover because its target and source are affine. Compose with the inverse affine spectrum isomorphism and the covering A to V. Composition stability of the pro-etale precoverage gives the desired singleton cover, and weak etaleness composes with A to X. Empty schemes and zero rings satisfy the same construction.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_single_wContractible_affine_cover
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (V : X.ProEt) (hVqc : CompactSpace V.left) :
    ∃ (D : CommRingCat.{u}) (f : Spec D ⟶ X) (hf : WeaklyEtale f)
      (g : @Scheme.ProEt.mk X _ f hf ⟶ V),
      IsWContractibleRing D ∧
        Presieve.singleton g ∈ (Scheme.ProEt.precoverage X) V
